description: Frozen, single-source definitions for the 3D ISAW contact-motif analysis. Code must read fixed/scaled bin and graph definitions from here (or from the matching constants in isaw_contact_observables.py, which mirror this file).

chain_length_convention.note: Every output file records both n_beads and n_steps to prevent off-by-one errors.

contact_definition.contact_indicator: Delta_ij = 1 when beads i and j occupy nearest-neighbour lattice sites and j - i > 1; else 0
contact_definition.counting_rule: each unordered nonbonded nearest-neighbour pair counted exactly once
contact_definition.parity_constraint: all valid contact contour separations r = j - i are odd on the simple cubic lattice

pair_topology_definitions.canonicalization: each contact sorted to (i, j) with i < j before comparison; result symmetric under swapping the two contacts
pair_topology_definitions.priority: shared_endpoint takes priority; with four distinct endpoints exactly one of disjoint/nested/interleaved applies
pair_topology_definitions.shared_endpoint: the two contacts share at least one bead index
pair_topology_definitions.exhaustiveness: sum over the four exclusive classes equals C(m,2)

fixed_bin_definitions.rationale: long threshold is a fixed odd separation (15), not floor(N/3), so no class is empty for N=30 or N=44

scaled_bin_definitions.note: local_scaled is empty for N=30 (min r=3 gives exactly r/N=0.10 -> mesoscopic); this is reported as a warning, never silently produced.

bin_scheme_independence: The fixed and scaled schemes are INDEPENDENT. Each is exhaustive and non-overlapping over the valid (odd, r>=3) separations within its own definition. The two schemes may and do overlap with each other because they answer different questions. The full m_r vector remains authoritative; binned counts are convenience aggregates.

graph_definitions.vertices: bead indices participating in at least one nonbonded contact
graph_definitions.S_max: number of vertices in the largest connected component
graph_definitions.S_max_definition: largest_component_vertices; a finite-size structural indicator, not automatically a thermodynamic order parameter
graph_definitions.largest_component_tie_break: ties on vertex count broken by smallest minimum vertex index (deterministic)
graph_definitions.cycle_rank: edges - vertices + components (computed on the contact graph)
graph_definitions.edge_conservation: sum over components of component edges equals m

m_r_authority: m_r (the dense contour-separation histogram, length n_beads) is the authoritative contour-separation representation. sum_r m_r == m. Even entries are zero.

sign_conventions.reduced_bias_b_T: b(T) is the reduced contact bias; sampling weight P(C|T) ∝ exp[-m(C) b(T)] so favorable (more-contact) configurations have b(T) < 0
sign_conventions.coupling_K_T: K(T) = -b(T); contact weight w ∝ q^m with q = exp(K)
sign_conventions.contact_weight_q_T: q(T) = exp(K(T)) = exp(-b(T)); K is authoritative because q can overflow
sign_conventions.swap_criterion: log A = u(C_i,T_i) + u(C_j,T_j) - u(C_j,T_i) - u(C_i,T_j)
